title: Implement byte instruction variants
description: Most instructions need byte variants (MOVB, CMPB, BITB, BICB, BISB, CLRB, INCB, DECB, etc.). Currently only TSTB is implemented. Byte operations are essential for string processing and character I/O.

title: Implement Windows console input support
description: Console check_input() is Unix-only. Need Windows-specific implementation using Windows Console APIs or thread-based approach for non-blocking input.

title: Implement core branch instructions
description: Missing branch instructions: BR, BNE, BEQ, BMI, BGE, BLT, BGT, BLE, BVC, BVS, BCC, BCS. Currently only BPL is implemented. Each branch tests appropriate PSW flags and modifies PC by signed offset if condition met.

title: Implement PDP-11 disassembler
description:
Create a PDP-11 disassembler to convert machine code back to assembly language. This is useful for analyzing binary programs, debugging, and understanding existing code.

Features needed:
- Disassemble PDP-11 instructions to MACRO-11 syntax
- Handle all addressing modes correctly
- Support both word and byte instructions
- Display addresses and opcodes alongside disassembly
- Format output for readability (labels, alignment)
- Handle data sections vs code sections
- Optional: Symbol table support for better readability

Can reuse existing Instruction::from() decoder and Display implementation as foundation.

title: Implement KW11-L line time clock
description:
Implement the KW11-L line time clock peripheral for timing and periodic interrupts.

**Registers:**
- LKS (0o177546): Line Clock Status Register

**Key features:**
- 60 Hz (or 50 Hz) periodic interrupt capability
- Essential for time-based operations and task scheduling
- Simple register at 0o177546

**Implementation approach:**
- Memory-mapped register
- Can initially just set ready bit
- Full interrupt support can be added later when interrupt system is implemented

**Priority:** Lower than console I/O but important for running Unix and other time-dependent software.

title: Implement TM11 magnetic tape controller
description: Implement TM11 magnetic tape controller for tape I/O operations. Lower priority than console and disk but useful for backup and data transfer operations. Registers at 0o172520-0o172532.

title: Reorganize devices into dedicated devices/ directory
description: Move device modules (console, rk11, kw11, mmio) from cpu/ to devices/ directory for better organization. This will improve code structure and make it easier to add new devices or extract them to separate crates in the future.

title: Fix XOR instruction opcode pattern
description:
XOR instruction pattern is incorrectly set to 0o074000..=0o074777

Actual XOR pattern should be 0o070000..=0o077777
- Format: 0o07RSSS where R=register (bits 8-6), SSS=source operand (bits 5-0)
- Example: 0o072027 = XOR R0, 27(PC) is currently not matching

This is causing XOR instructions to be reported as unsupported.

title: Consider async I/O architecture for real-time devices
description: Investigate hybrid architecture for real-time devices: async I/O (stdin/console, wall-clock timing) while keeping device state machines synchronous for determinism. Benefits: realistic timing, independent testing. Trade-off: complexity vs simple architecture. Revisit when multiple devices would benefit (network, serial ports, etc.)

title: Fix console input timing - input consumed before ODT prompt appears
description: Console input (like 'G' command) is being read from stdin immediately when the emulator starts, but the ODT prompt (@) doesn't appear until after ~101k instructions. By the time ODT is ready to accept commands, the input has already been consumed and lost. Need to delay console input checking until after the prompt is detected.

title: Implement comparison and bitwise traits for Word/Byte
description: Add PartialOrd, Ord, Hash, BitOr, BitXor, Not, Shl, Shr traits to Word and Byte types to simplify tests and prepare for additional instructions (BIS, BIC, ASR, MUL, DIV)

title: Add MMIO support for byte operations
description:
Byte operations (TSTB, MOVB, etc.) on memory-mapped I/O addresses currently read/write RAM directly instead of routing to peripheral devices. This breaks the boot ROM's polling loop which uses TSTB (R1) to check RK11 RKCS status.

Need to add MMIO checks in byte() and byte_mut() methods in impls.rs, similar to existing word-level MMIO handling. Should check if address is in I/O space and route to appropriate device (Console, RK11, KW11) via read_mmio_byte()/write_mmio_byte().

title: Implement ASH, ASHC, MUL, and SOB instructions
description:
Missing EIS (Extended Instruction Set) instructions:

1. MUL (Multiply): 0o070000-0o070777
   - Format: MUL src, reg
   - 16x16 → 32-bit signed multiply
   - Result in reg|reg+1

2. ASH (Arithmetic Shift): 0o072000-0o072777
   - Format: ASH src, reg  
   - Arithmetic shift register by count in src
   - Example: 0o072027 = ASH (PC)+, R0

3. ASHC (Arithmetic Shift Combined): 0o073000-0o073777
   - Format: ASHC src, reg
   - Arithmetic shift register pair by count
   
4. SOB (Subtract One and Branch): 0o077000-0o077777
   - Format: SOB reg, offset
   - Decrement register and branch if not zero
   - Common in loops

Current occurrence: 0o072027 (ASH) appearing in boot code

title: Implement XOR instruction
description:
Missing instruction: XOR (Exclusive OR)

Opcode pattern: 0o074RSS (where R=register, SS=source operand)
Format: XOR src, reg
Example: 0o072027 = XOR (PC)+, R0

Performs bitwise XOR of source with register, stores in register.
Sets N, Z, clears V, preserves C.

title: Implement interrupt system
description: Implement the PDP-11 interrupt system for peripheral interrupts. Includes interrupt priority levels, vector handling, PSW management, stack operations for PC/PSW save/restore, and RTI instruction. Required for DL11, KW11-L, and RK11 interrupt support.

title: Implement Word::as_le_bytes() method
description: The MemoryAccess trait requires as_le_bytes() but Word has todo!() stub. This is needed for proper byte order handling in memory operations.

title: Implement memory-mapped I/O framework
description: Create infrastructure for memory-mapped I/O to support peripherals. Currently RK11 registers are in RAM but need proper MMIO handling. Requires checking address ranges for I/O space (typically 0o160000-0o177777) and routing reads/writes to appropriate peripheral controllers instead of RAM.

title: Refactor code to remove all unsafe blocks
description:
Currently the codebase uses unsafe blocks in several places, primarily for pointer casts between Byte and u8 arrays. We should refactor to eliminate all unsafe code for better safety guarantees.

Areas to address:
- Word::as_bytes() in cpu/ram/word.rs uses unsafe pointer casts
- Any other unsafe blocks in the codebase

Consider approaches:
- Use std::mem::transmute with proper safety documentation
- Restructure data types to avoid the need for unsafe casts
- Use safe alternatives like bytemuck crate with appropriate derives

title: Implement core single operand instructions
description: Implement missing single operand instructions: COM (complement), INC (increment), DEC (decrement), NEG (negate), ADC (add carry), SBC (subtract carry), ROR/ROL (rotate), ASR (arithmetic shift right).

title: Implement ADD and SUB arithmetic instructions
description: Implement ADD (060000-067777) and SUB (160000-167777) double operand arithmetic instructions. These are essential for mathematical operations in PDP-11 programs.

title: Implement Add trait for Word
description: Currently Word type has AddAssign, SubAssign, Sub, and BitAnd implementations, but is missing the Add trait. This makes it impossible to use the + operator for addition (only += works). Implement ops::Add for Word to enable ergonomic arithmetic: let result = word1 + word2. This follows Rust conventions where types implementing AddAssign should also implement Add.

title: Implement DL11/KL11 console serial interface
description:
Implement console serial I/O for the PDP-11 emulator. This is the most critical peripheral for user interaction.

**Registers (at 0o177560-0o177567):**
- RCSR (0o177560): Receiver Control/Status Register
- RBUF (0o177562): Receiver Buffer (read-only)
- XCSR (0o177564): Transmitter Control/Status Register
- XBUF (0o177566): Transmitter Buffer (write-only)

**Key features:**
- Character input from stdin
- Character output to stdout
- Ready bits to indicate when device can accept/provide data
- Interrupt support (can defer for now)

**Implementation approach:**
- Memory-mapped I/O at standard addresses
- Polling mode initially (no interrupts)
- Simple stdin/stdout for console I/O

Without this, programs cannot perform basic I/O operations.

title: Add MMIO support for word write operations
description:
The word_mut() method doesn't route writes to MMIO devices. This prevents the boot ROM from successfully commanding the RK11 disk controller. All word writes (MOV, CLR, etc.) to I/O space go to RAM instead of the device.

Boot ROM successfully executes but writes to RK11 registers (0o177400-0o177412) are stored in RAM instead of triggering device operations. As a result, no disk read occurs, and the boot ROM jumps to address 0 which contains 0o000000 (HALT).

Solution: Add write_word() and write_byte() methods that check for MMIO and route appropriately. Convert all uses of *word_mut(op) = value to write_word(op, value).

Affected: ~18 word_mut() call sites across cpu.rs and bootrom.rs
Related: byte_mut() has the same issue but is less critical for boot.

title: Implement PSW flag manipulation instructions
description: Implement PSW flag manipulation instructions: CLC/SEC (carry), CLV/SEV (overflow), CLZ/SEZ (zero), CLN/SEN (negative), CCC/SCC (all flags), NOP (no operation).

title: Implement MACRO-11 compatible assembler
description:
Create a PDP-11 assembler compatible with DEC MACRO-11 syntax. This will allow writing and assembling PDP-11 programs without requiring external tools.

Features needed:
- Parse MACRO-11 assembly syntax (instructions, directives, labels)
- Support common directives (.WORD, .BYTE, .ASCII, .EVEN, etc.)
- Handle expressions and symbol resolution
- Generate object code (a.out format or raw binary)
- Provide error messages with line numbers
- Support octal constants (default) and other bases

This enables testing custom PDP-11 programs and developing system software.

title: Implement Index addressing modes
description:
Currently Index and IndexDeferred addressing modes are not implemented (marked with todo!()). These are essential for PDP-11 programs that use indexed addressing.

**Missing implementations:**
- Index addressing mode (mode 6): X(Rn) 
- IndexDeferred addressing mode (mode 7): @X(Rn)

**Files to update:**
- src/cpu/impls.rs (4 locations each in word, word_mut, byte, byte_mut methods)

**Implementation details:**
- Index mode: Add index offset to register value to get final address
- IndexDeferred mode: Add index offset to register value, then dereference to get final address
- Index offset comes from the next word in instruction stream

**Acceptance criteria:**
- All todo!() calls for Index/IndexDeferred are replaced with working implementations
- Tests pass with indexed addressing mode instructions
- Emulator can execute programs using indexed addressing

title: Add console interrupt support
description: Console device should generate interrupts when character ready. Currently has TODO comment in cpu.rs line 1012.

title: Implement MMU for memory management
description: Implement Memory Management Unit (MMU) with address translation for running larger programs and operating systems like Unix. Includes separate I/D spaces, relocation registers, and protection. Required for running Unix V6/V7. Registers at 0o177600-0o177776.

title: Complete JMP instruction implementation
description: JMP instruction is currently marked as todo!(). Need to implement unconditional jump that sets PC to the effective address of the operand. Should work with all addressing modes.

title: Implement BIC and BIS bit manipulation instructions
description: Implement BIC (040000-047777) Bit Clear and BIS (050000-057777) Bit Set double operand instructions. These are commonly used for bit field manipulation.

title: Implement JSR/RTS subroutine instructions
description: Implement JSR (004000-004777) Jump to Subroutine and RTS (000200-000207) Return from Subroutine instructions. Essential for function calls and stack management.

title: Convert repo to workspace
description: Convert this repo to cargo workspace to make it easier to split the codebase into multiple crates (i.e. separate lib and bin crates)

title: Add RK11 interrupt support
description: RK11 disk controller should generate interrupts on completion. Currently has TODO comment in cpu.rs line 1009.

title: Fix RUST_LOG environment variable not working
description:
The tracing subscriber configuration was using add_directive() which overrode the RUST_LOG environment variable. This prevented users from setting trace/debug levels via RUST_LOG=trace.

Fix: Use try_from_default_env().unwrap_or_else() pattern to respect RUST_LOG when set, and only default to INFO when not set.

title: Analyze missing features
description:
- Analyze code to understand what features are missing
- Enumerate missing features and create ticket tracking their implementation

title: Implement BHI branch instruction
description:
Missing branch instruction: BHI (Branch if Higher)

Opcode pattern: 0o101000-0o101377
Condition: C=0 AND Z=0 (for unsigned comparison)
Example: 0o101002 = BHI with offset +2

This is commonly used after CMP for unsigned comparisons.

title: Remove test_ prefix from test function names
Implement core branch instructions
description: Missing branch instructions: BR, BNE, BEQ, BMI, BGE, BLT, BGT, BLE, BVC, BVS, BCC, BCS. Currently only BPL is implemented.

title: Fix PSW flag calculations in existing instructions
description: Several instructions have incomplete PSW flag calculations: CMP missing V and C flags, TST and TSTB have incorrect logic (setting Z=negative instead of Z=zero). Need to fix flag calculations to match PDP-11 specification.

title: Implement DIV instruction
description:
Missing instruction: DIV (Divide)

Opcode pattern: 0o071RSS (where R=register, SS=source operand)
Format: DIV src, reg
Example: 0o071027 = DIV (PC)+, R0

32-bit signed integer divide:
- Dividend: reg|reg+1 (concatenated pair, reg must be even)
- Divisor: src operand
- Quotient: reg
- Remainder: reg+1

Sets N, Z, V (on overflow/divide-by-zero), C (always cleared).

title: Make emulator usable interactively - add quit condition
Create proper RK05 disk image with correct geometry
description:
Current rk0.img is 2MB (2^21 bytes) but should be 2,494,464 bytes per RK05 spec (203 cyls × 2 surfaces × 12 sectors × 512 bytes). Need to either:
1. Create a proper blank RK05 image with correct size
2. Document what OS/bootable image should be used
3. Consider using RT-11, Unix v6, or other PDP-11 OS image
4. Add validation that disk image is correct size on load

title: Implement IOT and BLOS instructions
description:
Missing instructions:

1. IOT (I/O Trap): opcode 0o000004
   - Causes trap to vector 20
   - Used for I/O operations in some systems

2. BLOS (Branch if LOwer or Same): opcode pattern 0o101400-0o101777
   - Condition: C=1 OR Z=1 (unsigned <= comparison)
   - Complement of BHI

Also investigate:
- 0o000014 - doesn't match standard patterns, might be data or TRAP variant
- 0o177774 - likely data, not instruction

title: Implement RK disk controller functionality
description: RK disk controller is currently stubbed with todo!() markers. Need to implement disk I/O functionality for reading disk images and handling RK11 disk controller registers and commands.

title: Replace debug println with tracing macros
Reduce IOT warning verbosity
description:
IOT instruction logs a warning every time it's encountered:
'IOT instruction not fully implemented - would trap to vector 020'

Since this is expected behavior (IOT is stubbed), change to debug level or add a flag to log it only once to reduce log noise.

title: Implement console input support for interactive use
description:
Currently the emulator cannot accept console input when running interactively. When the user reaches the ODT @ prompt and types 'G' (or any other command), the emulator appears stuck because:

1. check_input_unix() is stubbed out - doesn't actually read from stdin
2. console_input() method is marked #[cfg(test)] - only available in tests
3. Main loop doesn't attempt to read stdin

This prevents any interactive use of the emulator beyond boot.

Solution approaches:
1. Implement non-blocking stdin reading in check_input_unix()
2. Remove #[cfg(test)] from console_input() or add a non-test version
3. Integrate stdin polling into the main emulator loop
4. Consider using a terminal library that doesn't spawn threads (avoid termion issues)

Related: Previously removed termion to avoid thread spawn failures (commit 248cbe8)

title: Implement Add trait for Word type
description: Currently Word has AddAssign but not Add. Implement ops::Add for Word to allow direct addition (a + b) instead of only add-assign (a += b). This will make arithmetic operations more ergonomic and follow Rust conventions.
